externalTracking.troubleshoot.section1.d: Confirm the tracker is loading and firing events on your page.
externalTracking.troubleshoot.section1.s: Enable debug logs by adding `copy:data-debug="true"` to your tracking script tag.
Reload your site and open the browser console (`Cmd + Option + J` on macOS; `Ctrl + Shift + J` on Windows/Linux).

If no logs appear, verify the script loaded and `copy:data-debug="true"` is on that script tag. If logs appear but events are missing, inspect `POST /external-tracking/events` in the Network tab and verify the tracking ID and API endpoint.
externalTracking.troubleshoot.section2.d: Embed the form in an iframe without installing both iframe snippets from Installation › Tracking code › iframe forms.
Leave capture fields unnamed or disabled.
Use custom JavaScript handlers that bypass or block the native submit event — handlers are otherwise supported.
In Settings, enable Form analytics and Form submissions.
Render the form directly in the page DOM inside a valid `<form>` element.

Give every field you want to capture a `name` attribute and ensure it is not disabled. For reliable contact matching, include `copy:<input type='email' name='email'>`. Phone fields such as `copy:<input type='tel' name='phone'>` are also supported.
Submit through the form's native submit event using `copy:<button type='submit'>` or `copy:<input type='submit'>`.
